Reuben_1: firstborn son of Jacob (Genesis 29:32), son of Leah
Simeon_1: second-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:33), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Dan_1: fifth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:5), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Naphtali_1: sixth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:7), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Gad_1: seventh-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Asher_1: eighth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Issachar_1: ninth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:17), son of Leah
Zebulun_1: tenth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:19), son of Leah
Joseph_1: eleventh-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 30:24)
Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Joshua_1: 1 of the 12 spies (called Hoshea)- from Ephraim (Numbers 13:8), servant of Moses (Exodus 17:9)
Samuel_1: the leader of the tribe of Simeon (Numbers 34:20) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Ammihud_2: father of Samuel, the leader of the tribe of Simeon (Numbers 34:20)
Elidad_1: the leader of the tribe of Benjamin (Numbers 34:21) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Bukki_1: the leader of the tribe of Dan (Numbers 34:22) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Hanniel_1: the leader of the tribe of Manasseh (Numbers 34:23) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Kemuel_2: the leader of the tribe of Ephraim (Numbers 34:24) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Elizaphan_1: the leader of the tribe of Zebulun (Numbers 34:25) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Paltiel_1: the leader of the tribe of Issachar (Numbers 34:26) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Ahihud_1: the leader of the tribe of Asher (Numbers 34:27) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
Pedahel_1: the leader of the tribe of Naphtali (Numbers 34:28) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
